hypothesis: Steep normalized 25-delta put skew predicts underperformance (Xing/Zhang/Zhao 2010): top-tercile rr25Norm symbols underperform bottom-tercile by at least 0.5% over the next 10 trading days, with the sign stable across both halves of the sample.
activates: VETO on new bullish long/debit entries in top-tercile rr25Norm symbols. Activation requires a human commit flipping a named config flag and citing this rule id.

hypothesis: Elevated put/call volume ratio at the open snapshot predicts 10-day underperformance. Honest caveat: this is the UNSIGNED, partial-day proxy of the literature signal (Pan/Poteshman need signed opening volume, which delayed feeds cannot provide) — the bar for activation is the same, the prior is weaker.
activates: Entry-quality input only via a further pre-registered proposal — never a direct gate from this rule alone.

hypothesis: Unusually high options dollar volume relative to stock dollar volume (O/S ratio, Johnson/So 2012) predicts larger absolute 10-day moves in the direction informed traders lean. Unsigned partial-day proxy — same caveat as pc-ratio.
activates: Entry-quality input only via a further pre-registered proposal — never a direct gate from this rule alone.

signal: atmIV - rv21 (per-symbol variance risk premium, measured on our own journal)
hypothesis: Credit spreads opened in symbols whose median (atmIV - rv21) is NEGATIVE (no harvestable variance risk premium) show a profit factor at least 0.5 lower than credit spreads in positive-VRP symbols.
activates: config.entries.requirePositiveVrpForCredit — a PURE TIGHTENING (blocks credit spreads in negative-VRP symbols, never adds trades). Activation requires a human commit citing this rule id.

hypothesis: Credit spreads whose open-to-close window contains an FOMC decision day show a profit factor at least 0.5 lower than credit spreads that do not span FOMC.
activates: Block NEW credit-spread entries whose expiry spans an FOMC date. Warnings ship today; the block requires this rule to pass on forward trades plus a human commit citing this id.

hypothesis: Positions ENTERED on an FOMC decision day (10:50 ET entry, 14:00 ET decision) underperform non-FOMC-day entries by PF >= 0.5.
activates: Block new entries on FOMC decision days. Insufficient or contrary evidence leaves the warning permanent and the block never ships.

signal: hvP20 vs hv20 as the IV-regime denominator
hypothesis: The hv20- and Parkinson-based IV regime classifications disagree on at least 15% of rows, AND among disagreement rows the realized VRP sign (atmIV - rv21) agrees with the Parkinson classification at least 60% of the time — evidence the router's denominator should be A/B tested forward.
activates: Permission to PROPOSE a new forward A/B of the regime denominator — NEVER a retroactive swap of the frozen router.
